title: 軌道車輛轉向架組裝
summary: 從裝配基準走到輪重和振動檢查，追蹤每條載荷路徑的接頭。
summaryEn: Move from assembly datums to wheel loads and vibration, tracing joints along every load path.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創汽車與交通工具教學。所有數值均為明示假設，不是同名車輛的實測規格、認證或維修設定。使用試算表、紙面圖、合成資料及自行準備的離線模型；不提供真實高壓、道路、壓力設備或控制器操作授權。
scopeEn: Original automotive teaching based on public principles. All numerical inputs are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vehicle specifications, certification criteria or maintenance settings. Use worksheets, paper diagrams, synthetic data and offline models you prepare; no authorization for real high-voltage, road, pressure-equipment or controller operations.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 定位基準與尺寸鏈：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Datums and dimensional chains: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 定位基準與尺寸鏈 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Datums and dimensional chains and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 本課觀察對象為轉向架框、軸箱及二系支承。零件自由度由基準面與定位點約束；只有不相關的標準不確定度才可平方和合併。
steps.instructionEn: This course follows bogie frame, axleboxes and secondary supports. Datums and locators constrain degrees of freedom; root-sum-square combination requires uncorrelated standard uncertainties.
steps.observation: 獨立教學工況，非原廠或實測規格；跨單元整合須先統一輸入及分配邊界：兩獨立定位偏差 u=sqrt(0.20²+0.15²) mm；同一基準量測；計算結果=0.25 mm。
steps.observationEn: Independent teaching operating point, not OEM or measured specifications; reconcile inputs and allocation boundaries before cross-unit integration: Two independent location uncertainties u=sqrt(0.20²+0.15²) mm; one measurement datum; result=0.25 mm.
steps.failure: 重定位漂移可能是夾具間隙或量具零點；先以同一標準件重測兩者。
steps.failureEn: Reseating drift may arise from fixture clearance or gauge zero; check both against the same reference.
steps.check: 獨立誤差得到0.25 mm；共同基準偏差須另列相關項，不能當成保證公差。 將此判讀連回轉向架框、軸箱及二系支承的資料，記錄量測位置、邊界與資料版本。
steps.checkEn: Independent uncertainties give 0.25 mm; shared datum bias needs a covariance term and is not a guaranteed tolerance. Relate this interpretation to bogie frame, axleboxes and secondary supports and record measurement locations, boundaries and data version.

steps.objective: 重算 軸重與支承反力 的教學算例，核對單位與適用條件。
steps.objectiveEn: Recalculate the teaching example for Axle load and support reaction and verify units and assumptions.
steps.instruction: 獨立教學工況，非原廠或實測規格；跨單元整合須先統一輸入及分配邊界：R=mg/2；m=18000 kg、兩軸平均；計算結果=88.29 kN。
steps.instructionEn: Independent teaching operating point, not OEM or measured specifications; reconcile inputs and allocation boundaries before cross-unit integration: R=mg/2; m=18000 kg shared equally by two axles; result=88.29 kN.
steps.observation: 獨立教學工況，非原廠或實測規格；跨單元整合須先統一輸入及分配邊界：R=mg/2；m=18000 kg、兩軸平均；計算結果=88.29 kN。
steps.observationEn: Independent teaching operating point, not OEM or measured specifications; reconcile inputs and allocation boundaries before cross-unit integration: R=mg/2; m=18000 kg shared equally by two axles; result=88.29 kN.
steps.failure: 懸吊高度不均或重心偏移會使輪重不均；比較四角反力而非只看總重。
steps.failureEn: Uneven suspension height or center-of-mass offset causes wheel-load imbalance; compare corner loads.
steps.check: 每軸88.29 kN；只有對稱假設成立才平均分配。 將此判讀連回轉向架框、軸箱及二系支承的資料，記錄量測位置、邊界與資料版本。
steps.checkEn: Each axle carries 88.29 kN only under the symmetry assumption. Relate this interpretation to bogie frame, axleboxes and secondary supports and record measurement locations, boundaries and data version.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 在試算表、紙面剖面或自行準備的離線教學模型中：在轉向架模型標車體支承、軸箱與輪軌接點，逐節列平衡方程。 交付物：本單元計算表、可重現條件與一項尚無法判定的結論。
knowledge.textEn: Using a worksheet, paper section or an offline teaching model you prepare: Mark body supports, axleboxes and contacts on a bogie and write equilibrium equations along the load path. Deliver a calculation sheet, reproducible conditions and one conclusion that the evidence cannot establish.

quiz.explanationEn: Independent teaching operating point, not OEM or measured specifications; reconcile inputs and allocation boundaries before cross-unit integration: R=mg/2; m=18000 kg shared equally by two axles; result=88.29 kN. Each axle carries 88.29 kN only under the symmetry assumption. Relate this interpretation to bogie frame, axleboxes and secondary supports and record measurement locations, boundaries and data version.
